content_of_post_to_comment: Copy editors: this one's for you! How would you edit this sentence? And why?? "The council comprised of five elves, two dwarves and a dragon, who nobody trusted." Drop your edit in the comments. If you’d leave it as is, give us your defense ⬇️
comment: The comma before “who” makes the distrust apply to all three species, but the dragon’s reputation might be the reason the council itself is mistrusted. Punctuation quietly changes the politics of the sentence.
